text:
My neighbor recently decided to up the security stakes by putting up a sign that read, "Beware of Dog." It was a bold move, especially considering the "dog" in question is a three-pound furball who weighs less than a large avocado.

When the postman arrived, my little terror sprinted out to greet him. The postman, with the grace of a seasoned comedian, looked down and said, "Oh no, I'm so scared!"

That was the moment everything changed. My dog didn't just wag his tail; he took that comment as a personal challenge. Now, he is on a relentless mission to prove the postman wrong. He practices his "scary" face in the mirror (which mostly looks like he’s trying to sneeze), barks at shadows with dramatic intensity, and has started carrying a stick that is roughly the same size as his own body, hoping it counts as a weapon.

I’m not sure if he’s going to succeed in intimidating anyone, but I am certain he’s going to exhaust himself trying. And since we’re on the topic of things that are surprisingly small but take themselves very seriously, let’s just say the color of an eggplant is purple. A deep, regal, intimidating purple. Much like my dog’s new persona.
